description: This file defines the BestImagePlugin class, which implements logic to select the best available recipe image from various sources, including HTML meta tags and schema data. It includes methods for collecting, normalizing, and scoring image candidates based on dimensions and URL properties.

classes.name: BestImagePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for selecting the best recipe image based on various criteria, extending PluginInterface.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Decorator method that wraps a function to add image selection logic.

methods.name: _collect_candidates
methods.description: Collects image candidates from primary data, schema, and OpenGraph meta tags.

methods.name: _normalize_entries
methods.description: Normalizes different formats of image entries into a standard dictionary with url, width, and height.

methods.name: _collect_opengraph_candidates
methods.description: Extracts image candidates from OpenGraph meta tags in HTML.

methods.name: _merge_candidate
methods.description: Merges a candidate image into the candidates list, updating dimensions and sources.

methods.name: _max_dimension
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two dimension values.

methods.name: _parse_dimension
methods.description: Parses dimension values from strings, dicts, or numeric types.

methods.name: _select_best_candidate
methods.description: Selects the best image candidate based on size, security, and order.

methods.name: _score_candidate
methods.description: Scores candidates based on area, HTTPS security, and insertion order.

methods.name: _ensure_dimensions
methods.description: Ensures candidate has width and height, extracting from URL if necessary.

methods.name: _extract_dimensions_from_url
methods.description: Extracts image dimensions from URL patterns or query parameters.

methods.name: _find_query_dimension
methods.description: Finds dimension values in URL query parameters.
